arStrings.szText:
The Base Spirit of a Skill cast grants:
{icon:bullet,1.2} {c_label}Eagle:{/c} {c_random}[Affix_Value_1|%+|]{/c} Movement Speed
{icon:bullet,1.2} {c_label}Gorilla:{/c} {c_random}[Affix_Value_1|%|]{/c} Damage Reduction
{icon:bullet,1.2} {c_label}Jaguar:{/c} {c_random}[Affix_Value_1|%+|]{/c} Attack Speed
{icon:bullet,1.2} {c_label}Centipede:{/c} {c_random}[Affix_Value_1 / Affix."Static Value 0"|1%|]{/c} Life per Second

Casting a Skill of a different Base Spirit:
{icon:bullet,1.2} Swaps to the new bonus
{icon:bullet,1.2} Increases Core Stats by {c_number}[Affix."Static Value 1"*100|%+|]{/c} for {c_number}[Affix."Static Value 2"]{/c} seconds.
